Bug Title: Bulk import deletes the entire customer_yearly_sales table with no confirmation and no transaction
Preconditions: User on Segmentation page; existing yearly sales data present
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open Customer Segmentation > import tab 2. Click 'استيراد البيانات' (runImport)
Expected Result: Import is confirmed, atomic, and reversible; existing data is not lost on failure
Actual Result: runImport runs DELETE on customer_yearly_sales with .gte('id',0) (all rows) then inserts in batches; no confirm dialog, no transaction. A mid-batch failure leaves data permanently deleted/partial
Suspected Root Cause: Delete-then-insert without transaction/RPC; no confirmation gate
Recommended Fix: Wrap in a Postgres RPC/transaction or use upsert-only; add explicit confirm dialog and a dry-run count; never delete before successful insert
Status: Fixed (branch claude/dashboard-review-5oyboy) — import upsert-only + confirm

Bug Title: Rep handover is non-atomic; final deactivate failure leaves two active reps and double-counted targets
Preconditions: Existing active rep with a monthly target
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Setup > handover a rep 2. Simulate failure on the final update (deactivate old rep)
Expected Result: Handover is all-or-nothing; exactly one rep active afterwards
Actual Result: Creates new rep + splits target, then deactivates old rep. Rollback only covers the target-upsert step; if the final is_active=false update fails, both reps stay active and targets are double-counted
Suspected Root Cause: Multi-step mutation with no DB transaction; incomplete compensation
Recommended Fix: Move handover into a single Postgres RPC/transaction; or reorder + verify each step and compensate the last step too
Status: Fixed (branch claude/dashboard-review-5oyboy) — deactivate-before-split + full compensation

Bug Title: Daily entry save omits year/month; entries may never appear on dashboards if DB does not derive them
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Daily Entry > fill metrics > save
Expected Result: Saved row has year/month so Dashboard (.eq('year').eq('month')) and handover find it
Actual Result: Upsert payload has entry_date but no year/month. Dashboard and handover filter by year/month. Works only if the DB derives year/month via generated column/trigger — unverified
Suspected Root Cause: Client relies on an assumed DB-side derivation of year/month
Recommended Fix: Either set year/month explicitly in the payload, or confirm a generated column/trigger exists and document it; add an integration test
Status: Fixed (branch claude/dashboard-review-5oyboy) — year/month written explicitly (DB verify still advised)

Bug Title: Missing user_roles row grants admin nav + admin pages (role=null falls through to admin)

Status: Fixed (branch claude/dashboard-review-5oyboy) — fail-closed role + NoAccess screen

Bug Title: xlsx (SheetJS) dependency has HIGH advisories (prototype pollution + ReDoS) and parses user-uploaded Excel
Steps to Reproduce: 1. npm audit 2. Upload a crafted Excel to Segmentation
Expected Result: No high-severity parser vulnerabilities on user-supplied input
Actual Result: npm audit reports xlsx HIGH (GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6 prototype pollution, GHSA-5pgg-2g8v-p4x9 ReDoS); 'No fix available' for the pinned range. handleFileUpload parses untrusted files client-side
Recommended Fix: Upgrade to the SheetJS CDN build that patches these, or move parsing server-side with validation/size limits; validate columns and cap rows
Status: Partially fixed — parser hardened (type/size/row caps, try-catch); dependency upgrade still required at deploy
